parts.label: CC1101 tray
parts.note: Existing CC1101 vendor variant is unknown; measure it before printing.

parts.label: DC adapter and fuse tray
parts.note: Adapter and fuse dimensions are allocations; confirm both actual parts.

parts.label: LD2450 lid holder
parts.note: Keep restraints at board ends, clear of the active antenna face.

parts.label: BME680 ventilated pod
parts.note: For Adafruit BME680 STEMMA QT 3660; check wire passage and sensor clearance.

parts.label: BME680 pod lid
parts.note: Check the sensor and cable are not compressed on closure.

parts.label: BME680 pod support arm
parts.note: Print TWO identical arms; one STL file supplies both copies.

parts.label: Main enclosure base
parts.note: Print only after all actual modules and tray fits have been checked.

parts.label: Main enclosure lid
parts.note: Check the 0.8 mm radar window in the slicer; fit and radar performance remain unverified.
